goal: Make the short avatar dialogue natural, responsive and easy to understand while retaining both named speakers.

rubric.description: The second speaker directly responds to the first, and the next turn acknowledges the stated preference.
Language is concise, easy to understand, and free of confusing or repetitive dialogue.

verification.instructions: Assess only the supplied three-turn transcript. A score of 4 means clearly sufficient; 5 requires unusually strong evidence. State the limits of judging naturalness from a short text sample.
